summary:
SPACE CHITCHAT : MOON & MARS TALES
     Space ChitChat is an interactive educational website designed to bring the stories of space exploration missions back to life.
Our project focuses on six spacecraft and missions on the Moon and Mars, helping children discover their stories, achievements, and historical importance through interactive maps, spacecraft images, story cards, and fun educational games.
By using NASA-related mission information and images, we transform complex space exploration information into an enjoyable and accessible learning experience. Our Mission: To make space history fun, interactive, and unforgettable while raising awareness about forgotten space missions and their achievementsSPACE CHITCHAT : MOON & MARS TALES

NASA DATA USED IN OUR PROJECT

Spacecraft & Mission Information

We used NASA mission resources to research six spacecraft from the Moon and Mars:

Moon Missions: {

Surveyor 1

Apollo 11 – Eagle Lunar Module

Apollo 15 – Lunar Roving Vehicle }

Mars Missions: {

Opportunity (MER-B)

Phoenix Mars Lander

Curiosity (MSL) }

Data We Used

Spacecraft images.

Mission descriptions and objectives.

Historical information and achievements.

Landing locations and mission facts.

How We Applied the Data We transformed NASA mission information into interactive story cards, allowing children to explore each spacecraft,
